reason: Mostly a valid, cheap bookkeeping check, and part (b) needs a fix. (a) As of 23:28Z, kernels status shows exp78b/79a/78a COMPLETE. The Kaggle API gives each kernel's last run (exp78a 18:56:53Z, exp78b 19:45:12Z, exp79a 20:32:27Z) but no version number (current_version_number=0, pull 403). CONTEXT logs one push per kernel, so -v 1 is almost certainly the dummy-gated version. The 26 Sep pre-submit rule (d) already requires 'kernel version COMPLETE' plus a dummy sha compare, so the only new part is logging the push time and version. (c) This is real: EXP_TOKEN takes the first exp token, and rows 43-46 already follow 'probe N: expXX = ...'. The one real risk is exp79a: a description starting 'exp70g + CI' would put it in the safetail family instead of safetail_ci and misread the CI gate. A --family ref override can fix that afterwards. (b) n2a 0.998/1.010 is inside the pre-registered band '~0.99-1.01' (CONTEXT 21:06Z), which was written while exp71's 0.995-1.007 was already known. So it is a PASS by the rule. The suggested switch to <=1.007 would change a pre-registered gate after the fact (spirit of R1-R10), so it must be struck. It is also a W2a (~08:45Z) matter, not an 'urgency now' W1 item. exp81's dummy is COMPLETE on Kaggle, but its node/runtime gate is not logged yet. This adds no mechanism and no score; it only guards against a wrong-version or wrong-family submit.
fix: Keep (a)+(c) as one pre-submit line per W1 file: right before submitting, run kernels status; log the push time (78b 19:45:12Z, 79a 20:32:27Z, 78a 18:56:53Z) and submit -v 1, the only pushed version. Any re-push invalidates the dummy PASS. Make the -m description start with the file's own token ('probe 47: exp78b = ...', 'probe 48: exp79a = exp70g + CI ...', 'probe 49: exp78a = ...'). After the submit, confirm the ledger shows exp79a as safetail_ci. For (b), log 'N2 proxy PASS (0.998/1.010 inside the pre-registered ~0.99-1.01 band, at its edge)' and strike the <=1.007 alternative, which is post-hoc. Log exp81's dummy gate (nodes within -2%/+1% of 121,252, 0 errors, <=1,920 s) before the W2a decision. Do not change W1 (exp78b, exp79a, exp78a).
realistic_gain: 0 LB points. It is insurance against a rare wrong-version or wrong-family submit (probability <~2%), and it keeps the N2 gate audit-clean.
